Grow Together - Brooklyn

Grow Together is on Coney Island Avenue in southern Brooklyn, one of two licensed dispensaries we track in the Coney Island area, with about 780 products from 99 brands. Vapes (233), flower (214) and pre-rolls (211) are close to a three-way tie, which gives the menu a balance that is rare for a shop this size. Edibles are a smaller section at 116, and it carries only a handful of concentrates with no tinctures or topicals listed.

Two brands dominate the vape wall: STIIIZY with 62 listings and Rove with 60, making this one of the deepest STIIIZY and Rove selections in Brooklyn. Ruby Farms pre-rolls, Revert and Hashtag Honey flower, and MFNY round it out. The cheapest items are 1906 pill packs at $5 and Weed Water sparkling cans at $5.62. High Tidez on Surf Avenue, closer to the boardwalk, is the other licensed shop in the area with about 720 products and a stronger pre-roll focus.

Good to know
  • About 780 products and 99 brands, evenly spread across vapes, flower and pre-rolls (roughly 210 to 230 each).
  • STIIIZY (62) and Rove (60) make up a large share of the vape selection.
  • No tinctures or topicals listed, and only about 10 concentrates; this is a flower, pre-roll and vape shop.
  • High Tidez on Surf Avenue is the nearby alternative, with more pre-rolls and edibles.
Grow Together - Brooklyn FAQ
What is Grow Together strongest in?

Vapes, specifically STIIIZY and Rove, which together have more than 120 listings. Flower and pre-rolls are each well over 200 options, so it is a good general-purpose shop for inhalable products.

Does it carry tinctures or topicals?

Not at last check. The menu is built around vapes, flower, pre-rolls and edibles. For tinctures or topicals in southern Brooklyn, Twenty8gramz or Quality Control NY in Sheepshead Bay both list a few.

How does Grow Together compare to High Tidez?

Grow Together has slightly more products (about 780 to 720) and a far bigger vape section. High Tidez has more pre-rolls (252 to 211), more edibles, and is the closer shop to the Coney Island boardwalk.
